title: QUANTITY OF ROYAL DOULTON 'PAC...
reason: Large lot (about 40 or more pieces) of current-range Royal Doulton Pacific dinnerware; new retail would be many hundreds of dollars and used value is likely $200 or more.
findings: Large modern blue and white dinner service in two designs: cobalt splatter on white (Pacific Splash) and blue dot pattern (Pacific Dots), matching the Royal Doulton Pacific range. Counts are approximate from the stacks: about 14 dinner and side plates, 2 large feature plates (one splash, one dots), 6 cereal bowls, about 8 shallow pasta bowls, 1 mug, 4 small splash bowls, 3 small splash plates, 2 large dotted bowls and 3 small dotted plates, so roughly 40 to 45 pieces. No backstamp is visible in either photo, so the Royal Doulton attribution rests on pattern recognition only. Retail price check (Minimax, seen in search results 19/10/2026): one Pacific Splash 28.5 cm dinner plate $24.45 (was $34.95); six Pacific 28 cm dinner plates $139 (was $199).
condition: Glaze looks clean and glossy, no chips or cracks visible in the photos. Undersides and the backs of stacked pieces not shown.
rescore_note: Large modern Royal Doulton Pacific Splash and Dots set of about 40 clean pieces (pattern is distinctive though no backstamp seen); used dinnerware resells well below new, where one plate is A$24.45 (minimax.com.au Pacific Splash dinner plate, seen 19/10/2026), so my estimate is $150 to $230.
